rows.en: 08  Sweep Unknown Forces 2
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Well done making it back, all of you.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I have read the report <color(4)>Ruri<ce()> put together.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I still can hardly believe such a thing was happening where you had all gone missing...
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>But seeing the crew of the <color(4)>Gekko<ce()> who came with you, I can hardly deny it.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I never imagined this matter would turn out to be so serious.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>But now that I know the truth, we must prevent the worst outcome, whatever it takes.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I will grant you the authority of a <color(6)>special task force<ce()> with the right to act independently.
rows.notes: special task force matches meeting_briefing_015 rendering of tokumu butai.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Work together and do what you can to bring this under control and avert the crisis facing both worlds.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I am counting on you!
<topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Let me go over the current situation again, as a recap.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>We will show the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>'s activation status with an indicator called <book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()><thumbnail(195)>.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Calculated from the observed amount of <color(6)>Baldora particles<ce()>, this is the progress toward the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>'s full activation.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Right now, <book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()> has reached this stage, and the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> is still expanding.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Put simply, the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> is a kind of tunnel linking different dimensions.
rows.notes: Echoes encyclopedia_022 Wormhole entry ("tunnel-like entity linking different space-times").

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>When <book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()> hits <color(6)>100 percent<ce()>... reaches critical, the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> will fulfill its true function.
rows.notes: Percent spelled out (no bare %); "reaches critical" matches dialogue_02371 precedent.

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>In other words, an Earth-scale <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> will be born... and the worlds will be connected.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Once that tunnel is complete, the two Earths<thumbnail(197)> will be drawn to each other by gravity, causing catastrophic damage.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>And in the end the Earths will collide,<thumbnail(198)> collapsing from gravitational interference, and both Earths will be destroyed.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>If Earth is destroyed, it will affect all of humanity's habitats, including the colonies.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>In other words, humanity will face <color(6)>extinction<ce()>.
<thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Even now, <book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()> keeps steadily advancing.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>We must, as soon as possible, locate the holder of the key to stopping the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> - <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>From what has happened so far, <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> is thought to be gathering power while moving back and forth between the two worlds.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>But right now, we have no information on where he is headed.
<topic()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>My information network has turned up something that could be a lead.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Recently, near the colonies of the <book(23)>Hisago Plan<endbook()>, that <color(5)>unmanned mobile weapon<ce()> has been sighted several times.
rows.notes: unmanned mobile weapon(s) matches encyclopedia_022 unmanned-unit wording plus corpus "mobile weapons".

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>The <book(23)>Hisago Plan<endbook()> is a plan to develop solar system shipping routes using the <book(30)>Boson Jump<endbook()>.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Its relay points, the <book(24)>Terminal Colonies<endbook()>, have recently suffered repeated attacks by persons unknown.

<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>And mere moments ago, word came in that the <book(24)>Terminal Colony<endbook()> "<book(25)>Shirahime<endbook()><thumbnail(200)>" is under attack by <color(5)>mobile weapons<ce()> of unknown origin.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>The culprit is likely the same as in the earlier incidents. That man <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> may well be involved.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>I want you to head to <book(25)>Shirahime<endbook()><thumbnail(203)> at once and help defend the colony.
<thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>We have passed through the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>'s <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> and are now in satellite orbit.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Let us head for <book(25)>Shirahime<endbook()> as we are.
<topic()><operator(30000,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, new refit parts for the <color(4)>Ixbrau<ce()><thumbnail(201)> have arrived from a <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> lab.
rows.notes: Ixbrau locked (never Exbrau, terms_028); "refit parts" reused from scene 4003030 slot 34.

rows.en: <operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>It is gear for storming bases, a type built for high-speed combat.

uncertainties.issue: "Ruri-kun" rendered bare "Ruri"; no project convention found for -kun (dropped as with -san elsewhere).
"tonneru no you na mono" rendered "a kind of tunnel" to echo encyclopedia_022's Wormhole entry wording ("tunnel-like entity"); could also be "is like a tunnel".
"chikyuu kibo no" (Earth-scale) modifies Wormhole outside the <book(3)> tag in the source; kept the tag on "Wormhole" only, matching source tag placement.

"sugata ga ikudo ka kakunin sarete iru" (sighted several times) rendered with a singular "that unmanned mobile weapon" (treating it as a known threat/class); could also be pluralized "unmanned mobile weapons".

Thumbnail(201) placed directly after <color(4)>Ixbrau<ce()> per source order, ahead of "refit parts", slightly differing from scene 4003030 slot 34's placement of the thumbnail after "refit parts"; each follows its own source order.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title equals missions_019 "08  Sweep Unknown Forces 2".
Speakers confirmed via speaker_lookup: 30050 Kouichiro Misumaru, 30030 Ruri Hoshino, 30000 Faye Rochenante.
Slot 20 "Ruri-kun" -> "Ruri": honorific-drop is consistent corpus convention (matches 4004403 0/35 -kun-drop precedent). Accepted.
Slot 22 "Gekko" for "Gekkou-gou": matches meeting_terms_015 locked term.
Slot 25 "special task force" for tokumu butai: matches meeting_briefing_015 rendering.
Slots 29-41 Baldora Drive / Baldora Charge / Baldora particles / Wormhole: all locked terms per terms_028; tag placement checked token-for-token against source, identical order in every row.
Slot 33 "100 percent" spelled out (no bare %); "reaches critical" matches dialogue_02371 precedent.
Slots 44-49 Hisago Plan / Terminal Colony(-ies) / Shirahime: match encyclopedia_022 spelling exactly.

Slot 52 Ixbrau (never Exbrau) matches terms_028; thumbnail(201) placement verified against source token order for this row specifically (matches; differs from 4003030 slot 34 only because that row's own source order differs).

Slots 22/29/45/52 <book(9)>Federation<endbook()>: this is the player's own Earth Federation, a different entity from the antagonist "New Federation" (book(38)) that appears elsewhere in the corpus; no conflict with the orchestrator's "keep New Federation" ruling, which applies to that other faction.
Command-tag audit: every row's <...> tokens compared programmatically against tools/scene_source.py output for this resource - identical tokens, identical order, no additions/omissions.
Format audit: no non-ASCII characters, no literal newlines, no bare '%', no lowercase j/q anywhere in the file, all visible text under the 128-char limit (scripted check).
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 20: "-kun" drop has no written project rule beyond corpus precedent; kept.

Slot 26: source coordinates two goals, "bring the situation under control AND restore it" (shuushuu to kaifuku); EN compresses to "bring this under control", folding away the recovery/restoration half. Not a reversal, but two ideas became one - flagging per BASE_RULES even though the row passes.
Slot 32: "a kind of tunnel" vs "is like a tunnel" for tonneru no you na mono - stylistic choice only, left as translator's call.
Slot 44: singular "that unmanned mobile weapon" vs plural for a sighting confirmed "several times" - translator's own flagged uncertainty, both readings valid, left.

Slot 52: thumbnail(201) placement immediately after "Ixbrau" (matching this row's own source order) differs from scene 4003030 slot 34's placement after "refit parts" (that row's own source order); each is correct for its row, not an inconsistency.
